# LCARS — Recipes

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.mjs — edit src/meta/api.mjs, src/css/*.css or src/recipes/ instead. -->

Copy-paste patterns built only from framework classes. Each is rendered live at `examples/recipes/<id>.html`. Recipes marked *page* are full `<body>` contents; the rest are fragments for a frame's `__main`. Colors use theme roles, so every recipe follows `data-lcars-theme`.

## App shell (`app-shell`, page)

Full-page layout — header frame + body frame with sidebar navigation. Start every LCARS app from this.

```html
<div class="lcars-app">
  <header class="lcars-frame">
    <div class="lcars-frame__side">
      <div class="lcars-block lcars-grow lcars-c-secondary">01-1701</div>
    </div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__main">
      <h1 class="lcars-title">App name</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__elbow-bottom lcars-c-secondary"></div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__bar-bottom">
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-4 lcars-c-secondary"></span>
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-primary"></span>
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-2 lcars-c-tertiary lcars-round-end"></span>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="lcars-frame">
    <div class="lcars-frame__elbow-top"></div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__bar-top">
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-2"></span>
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-accent"></span>
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-6"></span>
    </div>
    <nav class="lcars-frame__side" aria-label="Main">
      <a class="lcars-block lcars-c-accent" href="#" aria-current="page">Overview</a>
      <a class="lcars-block lcars-c-tertiary" href="#">Reports</a>
      <a class="lcars-block lcars-c-secondary" href="#">Settings</a>
      <div class="lcars-block lcars-grow"></div>
    </nav>
    <main class="lcars-frame__main">
      <h2>Overview</h2>
      <p>Page content goes here.</p>
    </main>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Header only (`header-only`, page)

A single header frame to put LCARS chrome above an existing (non-LCARS) app. Scope with class="lcars" on the header's wrapper if the rest of the page keeps its own styles.

```html
<header class="lcars-frame" style="padding: 1rem">
  <div class="lcars-frame__side">
    <a class="lcars-block lcars-grow lcars-c-secondary" href="#">Home</a>
  </div>
  <div class="lcars-frame__main lcars-split">
    <span class="lcars-label">Stardate <span data-lcars-stardate></span></span>
    <h1 class="lcars-title" style="font-size: var(--lcars-text-2xl)">Console</h1>
  </div>
  <div class="lcars-frame__elbow-bottom lcars-c-secondary"></div>
  <div class="lcars-frame__bar-bottom">
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-6 lcars-c-secondary"></span>
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-primary lcars-round-end"></span>
  </div>
</header>
<main style="padding: 1rem 2rem">
  <p>Your existing application renders here.</p>
</main>
```

## Sidebar navigation (`sidebar-nav`, page)

Body frame whose sidebar holds the main navigation — current item marked with aria-current, a filler block, and an action pinned to the bottom.

```html
<div class="lcars-app">
  <div class="lcars-frame">
    <div class="lcars-frame__elbow-top">Nav</div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__bar-top">
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-3"></span>
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-secondary lcars-round-end"></span>
    </div>
    <nav class="lcars-frame__side" aria-label="Main">
      <a class="lcars-block lcars-block--short lcars-c-accent" href="#" aria-current="page">Dashboard</a>
      <a class="lcars-block lcars-block--short lcars-c-accent" href="#">Crew</a>
      <a class="lcars-block lcars-block--short lcars-c-tertiary" href="#">Missions</a>
      <a class="lcars-block lcars-block--short lcars-c-tertiary" href="#">Logs</a>
      <div class="lcars-block lcars-grow"></div>
      <button class="lcars-block lcars-c-alert" type="button">Sign out</button>
    </nav>
    <main class="lcars-frame__main">
      <h2>Dashboard</h2>
    </main>
    <div class="lcars-frame__elbow-bottom lcars-c-tertiary"></div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__bar-bottom">
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-tertiary lcars-grow-4"></span>
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-secondary lcars-round-end"></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Dashboard tiles (`dashboard-tiles`)

Grid of bracket cards showing KPIs with readouts and meters. Put this inside a frame's __main.

```html
<div class="lcars-grid" style="--lcars-grid-min: 16rem">
  <section class="lcars-bracket" aria-labelledby="t1">
    <h3 id="t1">Power</h3>
    <dl class="lcars-readout">
      <dt>Output</dt><dd>1.21 GW</dd>
      <dt>Efficiency</dt><dd>94%</dd>
    </dl>
    <div class="lcars-meter" role="meter" aria-label="Load" aria-valuenow="72" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" style="--lcars-value: .72"></div>
  </section>
  <section class="lcars-bracket lcars-c-tertiary" aria-labelledby="t2">
    <h3 id="t2">Crew</h3>
    <dl class="lcars-readout">
      <dt>On duty</dt><dd>412</dd>
      <dt>Off duty</dt><dd>602</dd>
    </dl>
    <span class="lcars-pill lcars-c-green">Nominal</span>
  </section>
  <section class="lcars-bracket lcars-c-accent" aria-labelledby="t3">
    <h3 id="t3">Sensors</h3>
    <div class="lcars-data" data-lcars-cascade="24" style="--lcars-data-cols: 4"></div>
  </section>
</div>
```

## Section heading (`section-heading`)

A bar with a title used to divide a page into sections, followed by the section content.

```html
<section aria-labelledby="sec-h" class="lcars-stack">
  <div class="lcars-bar">
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-round-start lcars-bar__fixed" style="width: 2.5rem"></span>
    <h2 id="sec-h" class="lcars-bar__title">Long range sensors</h2>
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-grow-6"></span>
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-secondary lcars-round-end"></span>
  </div>
  <p>Section content.</p>
</section>
```

## Data table (`data-table`)

Table with a heading bar, status pills, numeric columns and row actions.

```html
<section aria-labelledby="crew-h" class="lcars-stack">
  <div class="lcars-bar lcars-c-tertiary">
    <h2 id="crew-h" class="lcars-bar__title">Crew manifest</h2>
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-tertiary lcars-grow-6"></span>
    <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-secondary lcars-round-end"></span>
  </div>
  <table class="lcars-table">
    <thead>
      <tr><th>Name</th><th>Department</th><th>Status</th><th class="lcars-num">Hours</th><th><span class="lcars-sr-only">Actions</span></th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr>
        <td>Commander</td><td>Command</td>
        <td><span class="lcars-pill lcars-c-green">On duty</span></td>
        <td class="lcars-num">1,204</td>
        <td><button class="lcars-button lcars-button--sm lcars-c-accent" type="button">Open</button></td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>Lieutenant</td><td>Security</td>
        <td><span class="lcars-pill lcars-c-alert">Missing</span></td>
        <td class="lcars-num">873</td>
        <td><button class="lcars-button lcars-button--sm lcars-c-accent" type="button">Open</button></td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</section>
```

## Form (`form`)

Settings form in a bracket — text, select, textarea, switch, checkbox, range, a validation error and submit/cancel.

```html
<form class="lcars-bracket lcars-grid" style="--lcars-grid-min: 14rem" onsubmit="event.preventDefault()">
  <label class="lcars-field">
    <span class="lcars-label">Vessel name</span>
    <input class="lcars-input" name="name" required value="Enterprise">
  </label>
  <label class="lcars-field">
    <span class="lcars-label">Class</span>
    <select class="lcars-input" name="class">
      <option>Galaxy</option>
      <option>Sovereign</option>
      <option>Intrepid</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label class="lcars-field">
    <span class="lcars-label">Registry</span>
    <input class="lcars-input" name="registry" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="reg-err" value="NCC-17O1">
    <span class="lcars-hint" id="reg-err">Use digits only after NCC-</span>
  </label>
  <label class="lcars-field lcars-span-all">
    <span class="lcars-label">Notes</span>
    <textarea class="lcars-input" name="notes"></textarea>
  </label>
  <div class="lcars-cluster">
    <label class="lcars-choice"><input class="lcars-switch" type="checkbox" name="cloak"> Cloaking</label>
    <label class="lcars-choice"><input class="lcars-check" type="checkbox" name="saucer" checked> Saucer separation</label>
  </div>
  <label class="lcars-field">
    <span class="lcars-label">Max warp</span>
    <input class="lcars-range" type="range" name="warp" min="1" max="9.9" step="0.1" value="9.6">
  </label>
  <div class="lcars-cluster lcars-span-all">
    <button class="lcars-button" type="submit">Save</button>
    <button class="lcars-button lcars-c-muted lcars-round-end" type="reset">Cancel</button>
  </div>
</form>
```

## Tabs (`tabs`)

Segmented control / tabs built from small buttons with role="tab" and aria-selected; a few lines of JS switch panels.

```html
<div class="lcars-stack">
  <div class="lcars-cluster" role="tablist" aria-label="Scan mode">
    <button class="lcars-button lcars-button--sm lcars-round-start" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="tab-a" id="t-a">Short range</button>
    <button class="lcars-button lcars-button--sm lcars-square lcars-c-secondary" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-b" id="t-b">Long range</button>
    <button class="lcars-button lcars-button--sm lcars-round-end lcars-c-tertiary" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-c" id="t-c">Subspace</button>
  </div>
  <div role="tabpanel" id="tab-a" aria-labelledby="t-a"><p>Short range results.</p></div>
  <div role="tabpanel" id="tab-b" aria-labelledby="t-b" hidden><p>Long range results.</p></div>
  <div role="tabpanel" id="tab-c" aria-labelledby="t-c" hidden><p>Subspace results.</p></div>
</div>
<script>
  for (const tab of document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')) {
    tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
      for (const t of tab.parentElement.children) {
        t.setAttribute("aria-selected", t === tab);
        document.getElementById(t.getAttribute("aria-controls")).hidden = t !== tab;
      }
    });
  }
</script>
```

## Dialog (`dialog`)

Modal confirmation using a native <dialog class="lcars-dialog">; the frame inside gives it LCARS chrome.

```html
<button class="lcars-button lcars-c-alert" type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('self-destruct').showModal()">Self-destruct…</button>

<dialog class="lcars-dialog" id="self-destruct" aria-labelledby="sd-h">
  <form method="dialog" class="lcars-frame lcars-c-alert">
    <div class="lcars-frame__elbow-top">Auth</div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__bar-top">
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-alert lcars-grow-3"></span>
      <span class="lcars-block lcars-c-alert lcars-round-end"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__side">
      <div class="lcars-block lcars-grow lcars-c-alert"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="lcars-frame__main lcars-stack">
      <h2 id="sd-h">Confirm self-destruct</h2>
      <p>Auto-destruct will engage in five minutes.</p>
      <div class="lcars-cluster">
        <button class="lcars-button lcars-c-alert" value="confirm">Engage</button>
        <button class="lcars-button lcars-c-muted" value="cancel" autofocus>Abort</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>
```
